fields.statement: At 7166e92d (fixer commit adding machineHoldItems to daemonNotify) I read the diff and ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(inbox-load-hold|health-load-hold|daemon-load-hold)$': ok. inbox-load-hold.txtar writes daemon state fixtures and checks rhiza inbox --json: a load hold since 29 minutes gives no item, since 31 minutes gives exactly one load-high item naming the reading, limit and 'held for 31m0s'; memory hold since 29 minutes gives none, since 31 minutes gives one memory-low item; a later poll state with no hold gives empty items. go test -trimpath ./internal/tui/inboxapp/...: ok (renders load-high 'Machine load high' and memory-low 'Memory low' rows). go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestDaemonNotifyMachineHold: ok, a 31-minute hold of either kind notifies once over two polls with the expected message. The api Inbox subset's tests all passed; the package-level root-state guard flagged ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json, which live Claude Code statuslines rewrite, so this change did not cause it.
